finding: Nonbonded kernels ARE loaded from embedded sm_70 SASS: the default minimisation run JIT-compiled nothing while the CUDA_FORCE_PTX_JIT=1 positive control wrote 9 files, so the empty result is meaningful rather than an artifact of a disabled cache. BUT the full min+md run wrote 4 entries totalling 47471 bytes, so the PME-on-GPU path JIT-compiles at least one module and the image is NOT entirely JIT-free on dgx1.
caveat: The ORIGIN of those 4 entries is NOT determined by this probe. GROMACS places PME on the GPU via cuFFT, which ships its own PTX independently of GMX_CUDA_TARGET_COMPUTE, so the JIT may belong to a CUDA library rather than to libgromacs. Cheapest discriminator, not run: re-run md with -pme cpu against a fresh cache. Do NOT read this capture as evidence that libgromacs PTX is load-bearing on dgx1.
